AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app provides access to all Android platform Easter eggs. Operational Patterns: - Use 'listEasterEggs' to discover all available Easter eggs with API levels and version names. - Use 'searchEasterEggs' to find eggs by name, nickname, API level, or Android version. - Use 'launchEasterEgg' with the apiLevel obtained from 'listEasterEggs' or 'searchEasterEggs', then fire the returned 'launchIntent' PendingIntent to display the egg. - Use 'getEasterEggIcon' with the apiLevel to retrieve the egg's logo as PNG image bytes, for displaying the egg in cards or previews. - Use 'generateRandomCat' to create a Neko cat seed, then fire the returned 'editorIntent' PendingIntent to edit that cat in the Cat Editor. Constraints: - Eggs are read-only experiences; this app does not create or modify data.
